neighbours.label: the slot just before 'simultaneous(ly)' when the text is about whether two events happen at the same instant (relativity, timing), including the ' Sim' piece of a mid-text 'Simultaneously', as against the same frames about events in sequence or about other properties
fire: According to Einstein, observers moving at different speeds can disagree on which events are simultaneous.
The doors in the east wing slammed shut. Simultaneously, every window on the floor rattled.
Physicists asked whether the two distant lightning strikes were truly simultaneous for the train passenger.
The drummer hit the cymbal. Simultaneously, the singer leapt from the stage.
In relativity there is no absolute way to decide whether separated events are simultaneous.
The referee blew the whistle. Simultaneously, the stadium lights flickered and died.
The experiment tests whether the two photons are detected at simultaneous instants.
The judges argued over whether the two swimmers' finishes were simultaneous.
quiet: According to Einstein, observers moving at different speeds measure different lengths for the same rod.
The doors in the east wing slammed shut. Afterwards, every window on the floor was locked.
Physicists asked whether the two distant lightning strikes were caused by the same storm cloud.
The drummer hit the cymbal. Later that night, the singer signed autographs outside.
In relativity there is no absolute way to decide which observer is really at rest.
The referee blew the whistle. An hour later, the stadium was empty and quiet.
The experiment tests whether the two photons are polarized in the same direction.
The judges argued over whether the two swimmers had used legal turns.
